caption: The drawing features a single object, a vase, centered on a plain, cream-colored background. The vase is depicted in a rich, deep blue and has a glossy appearance with lighter highlights suggesting reflections on a shiny, possibly glass surface. The vase has a wide, flared rim, a narrower neck, and a bulbous body that tapers toward the base. The body of the vase is decorated with elongated, rounded vertical panels or grooves which are shaded with different tones of blue and purple, giving a sense of depth and curvature. The drawing is bordered by a fine, rectangular outline, and in the bottom right corner, the name "JANET RIZA" is written. There are no additional objects or details in the composition other than the vase on the neutral background.
title: Vase
